definition_from_master_dictionary: Length-decrease event when current length < before length OR previous current length. Pre/post pause are adjacent timestamp differences within 30s; recovery is first later text growth within 30s. Deletion rate=count/canonical events. Deletion-burst grouping uses collected timestamps without global resort across groups (technical caveat).

Named summary/count of positive intervals <=30000ms between consecutive canonical snapshots in the same device/package. Circadian assignment by later snapshot local hour; SD ddof=1, IQR=Q75-Q25, MAD=median absolute deviation, CV=SD/mean, spread=P95-P05.
